# ankra_alert_route (Resource)

A notification routing rule. A notification that matches every filter that is set is delivered to (`mode = "include"`) or withheld from (`mode = "exclude"`) the destination. Rules are evaluated in ascending `priority`; `stop_on_match` ends the walk at this rule. An unset filter matches anything. The counterpart of `ankra alerts routes create|update|delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Critical alert firings page the on-call engineer, and no later rule sees them.
resource "ankra_alert_route" "critical_to_pager" {
  destination_id = ankra_alert_destination.pagerduty.id
  kinds          = ["alert_trigger_fired"]
  severity       = "critical"
  priority       = 10
  stop_on_match  = true
}

# Every kind except pipeline runs goes to the platform channel.
resource "ankra_alert_route" "all_but_pipelines" {
  destination_id = ankra_alert_destination.platform_channel.id
  kinds          = ["pipeline_run_failed", "pipeline_run_succeeded"]
  kinds_negated  = true
}

# A provider scoped to one project still owns organisation-wide routes, which
# match every project's notifications.
resource "ankra_alert_route" "critical_everywhere" {
  destination_id    = ankra_alert_destination.pagerduty.id
  kinds             = ["alert_trigger_fired"]
  severity          = "critical"
  organisation_wide = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `destination_id` (String) Where matching notifications go: an `ankra_alert_destination` id, or `push:<audience>` for a mobile push audience.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Application whose notifications the route matches. Unset matches every application.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster whose notifications the route matches. Unset matches every cluster.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the route is evaluated. Defaults to `true`.
- `kinds` (List of String) Notification kinds the route matches, such as `alert_trigger_fired` or `pipeline_run_failed`. Unset matches every kind. Must not be empty or repeat a kind.
- `kinds_negated` (Boolean) Match every kind except those in `kinds`. Requires `kinds`. Defaults to `false`.
- `mode` (String) `include` delivers matching notifications to the destination, `exclude` withholds them from it. Defaults to `include`.
- `organisation_wide` (Boolean) Make the route organisation-wide, so it matches every project's notifications, even when the provider sets `project_id`. Needs alert management rights at organisation scope. Conflicts with `project_id`. Defaults to `false`. Changing it replaces the route, with the same import rule as `project_id`.
- `priority` (Number) Evaluation order; lower runs first. Defaults to `100`.
- `project_id` (String) Project to create the route in, by ID or slug, instead of the provider's project; the route then matches only that project's notifications, and every request for it is made in that project. Conflicts with `organisation_wide`. The platform cannot move a route, so moving it to another project replaces it; writing the same project differently (its slug instead of its ID) does not. The platform does not report a route's project, so this is kept as configured. To import a route in another project, use `<project>/<route id>`; after any import, the first apply adopts the configured `project_id` and `organisation_wide` without replacing the route.
- `reference_pattern` (String) Glob over the branch, tag or pull request a notification is about, such as `main`, `release/*` or `pull/*`. Unset matches every reference.
- `severity` (String) Severity the route matches: `info`, `warning` or `critical`. Unset matches every severity.
- `source_id` (String) Source (for example an alert id) whose notifications the route matches. Unset matches every source.
- `stop_on_match` (Boolean) Stop evaluating further routes once this one matches. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `destination_type` (String) `webhook` or `push`, as the platform reads `destination_id`.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the route.
- `kind` (String) The legacy single-kind filter the platform derives from `kinds`: the kind when `kinds` holds exactly one and is not negated, otherwise null.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Alert routes are imported by id.
terraform import ankra_alert_route.critical_to_pager 6b1c9e7a-2d4f-4e8a-b3c5-7f9d0a1e2b3c

# A route in another project than the provider's is imported as
# <project>/<route id>, the project by ID or slug.
terraform import ankra_alert_route.team_alerts data-team/0d2e8f4a-6c1b-4a7e-9f3d-2b5c8e1a4d6f
```
